note: PRE-DECLARED engineering-operability targets (§16/C8), fixed BEFORE the benchmark that judges them and NOT moved retroactively. These are ENGINEERING_EXECUTION_SLOs (wall-clock / provider-call bounds), separate from OWNER_MONETARY_SPEND_CEILING (dollars, owner-set). A tier over target = QA_ECONOMY_SLO=MISSED (a QA-system finding), never a reason to drop assurance. Baselines: feature measured ~68s/0-calls; RC measured ~155s.

feature.rationale: measured ~68s deterministic; 150s gives headroom for a growing suite while staying routinely practical for a solo builder

rc.rationale: measured ~155s; ≤60 provider calls matches the pre-registered stochastic envelope

production.rationale: declared/configured only — no actual Production measurement exists yet; do not fabricate
